Art Director

Game Show Group

The Art Director is a key creative leader responsible for shaping visual direction and driving the design execution for marketing campaigns across the Jeopardy! and Wheel of Fortune franchises. They will also work closely with the Game Show Group development team on new shows and sales creative. Working under the Executive Creative Director, this role conceptually and visually elevates all creative materials—broadcast promos, digital and social assets, brand campaigns, key art, pitch materials, on-set graphics, and franchise extensions. The ideal candidate blends strong conceptual thinking, hands-on design skills, and the ability to provide insightful feedback. This person is self-motivated and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced entertainment marketing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Direction & Concept Development



- Develop compelling visual concepts for integrated campaigns across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, and brand initiatives.
- Translate creative strategy into strong visual narratives, mood boards, style frames, and design systems.
- Partner closely with writers, producers, editors, and designers to shape cohesive creative ideas from pitch to final execution.
- Support the Executive Creative Director in defining and maintaining the brand expression and visual standards of both franchises. 

Design & Execution



- Create high-impact design assets including key art, promo graphics, digital/social layouts, typography systems, thumbnails, presentations, and animation briefs.
- Provide hands-on design work using Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, etc.) and/or Cinema 4D to bring concepts to life.
- Guide designers (static and motion) by delivering clear visual direction, templates, and design toolkits.
- Ensure all art delivered aligns with franchise identity, tone, and platform-specific requirements. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration



- Work closely with Marketing, Social & Digital, and Production to ensure creative alignment across all touchpoints.
- Collaborate with show-side partners and internal stakeholders to incorporate episodic elements, contestant imagery, set visuals, and talent photography into marketing materials.
- Provide creative support for franchise initiatives, partnership campaigns, special episodes, and development projects.

Ownership of Visual Standards



- Maintain brand consistency across all assets, ensuring visual integrity and quality regardless of platform or format.
- Help develop and document brand guidelines, toolkits, and asset libraries.
- Champion innovative creative approaches that modernize and elevate franchise visuals while honoring legacy.

Team Support & Creative Oversight



- Provide direction, feedback, and inspiration to designers and junior creative staff.
- Support the Executive Creative Director in shaping creative workflows, reviewing work, and ensuring deliverables meet both conceptual and technical standards.
- Help uphold a culture of creativity, collaboration, and high-performance within the creative team. 

Qualifications



- 6–8+ years of experience in creative marketing, design, or art direction within entertainment, broadcast, streaming, or digital media
- Strong portfolio showcasing campaign development, visual storytelling, brand design, and multi-platform creative.
- Expertise in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects) and experience guiding motion/animation workflows.
- Solid understanding of and/or technical proficiency in Cinema 4D with strong grasp of 3D systems and compositing.
- Strong conceptual thinker with the ability to translate ideas into polished, on-brand visual systems.
- Experience developing creative for iconic brands, entertainment IP, or character-driven storytelling is highly preferred.
- Exceptional communication and presentation skills; able to articulate ideas clearly to cross-functional partners.
- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable balancing multiple creative projects simultaneously.

Lustre is a branding and eCommerce agency that helps brands create memorable identities, compelling digital experiences, and high-performing creative assets.

About the Role


Simply put, we're looking for a highly skilled image editor and retoucher who has embraced AI as an extension of their creative toolkit.


The ideal candidate has a background in retouching, photography, post-production, digital art, or visual design and has adopted AI to enhance the speed and caliber of their work.


You'll work alongside our Creative Director and design team to transform product photography, renders, and existing brand assets into sophisticated, photorealistic campaign imagery, social content, ecommerce assets and advertising creative.


This position is being hired as a contractor role, with the potential to transition to a full-time position based on business needs, workload, and performance.


Responsibilities

- Integrate products, packaging, and brand assets into AI-assisted environments while maintaining realism, lighting consistency, and brand and label accuracy
- Transform existing product photography into premium campaign-ready imagery
- Create lifestyle scenes and environments using AI-assisted workflows
- Extend existing photography into new visual concepts, seasonal campaigns, and marketing assets
- Retouch, composite, and refine imagery to ensure a polished and realistic final result
- Collaborate with designers and creative leadership to execute visual concepts
- Produce and scale assets for ecommerce, social media, packaging, digital advertising, presentations, and marketing campaigns
- Ensure imagery aligns with established brand standards, detailed briefs, and creative direction
- Maintain high standards for realism, consistency, and production quality
- Stay current with emerging tools and workflows across AI-assisted image creation


Required Skills

- Advanced Adobe Photoshop proficiency, including masking, compositing, retouching, color correction, lighting adjustments, background replacement, and perspective correction, prop placement and adjustment
- Experience with AI-assisted image creation and editing platforms such as ChatGPT Image Generation, Midjourney, Nanobanana, Adobe Firefly, Flux, Magnific AI, Topaz AI, or similar tools
- Ability to transform product photography, renders, and existing brand assets into photorealistic campaign imagery and lifestyle scenes
- Strong compositing skills, including the ability to seamlessly combine generated and photographic elements into a cohesive final image
- Strong understanding of photography principles, including lighting, shadows, reflections, composition, depth of field, style consistency, and visual realism
- Ability to create consistent, production-ready image sets across ecommerce, advertising, social media, and marketing channels at any size
- Exceptional attention to detail and a strong eye for luxury, premium, and consumer brand aesthetics


What Success Looks Like

- Creating imagery that feels indistinguishable from traditional photography
- Delivering assets that support real business and marketing objectives
- Producing visual content efficiently without sacrificing quality
- Contributing to the evolution of Lustre's visual production capabilities
- Helping clients reduce the cost and complexity of traditional photoshoots while maintaining premium creative standards


Engagement Details

- Remote contractor position (potential to transition into full time)
- Flexible hours
- Ongoing project-based work
- Opportunity to grow with an emerging service offering
- Collaboration with an experienced branding and creative team


Application Process
As part of your application, please email work@lustre.nyc 2–5 examples of AI-assisted visual work that you have personally created.
For each example, please include:

- The original source images, renders, or assets
- The final images
- A brief explanation of the creative objective
- The tools used (e.g. Photoshop, Midjourney, Nanobanana, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
- A summary of your workflow and production process
- An estimate of the total time spent creating the final result
We are particularly interested in understanding how you think, art direct, problem solve, and execute, not just the final output.

What You'll Do


Brand Direction & Visual Identity
Own the visual language of the brand, ensure it is elevated and coherent across every touchpoint, and evolve it while growing equity.

From the Gold Gala stage to partner activations, Gold House's events are among the highest-profile expressions of our brand. The standard is set by the best in culture and entertainment — and this role is responsible for meeting it.

- Provide end-to-end creative direction for Gold House tentpole events, including the annual Gold Gala — from environmental branding, stage design, and lighting direction to print collateral, digital extensions, and content capture strategy

- Collaborate with event production teams, fabricators, and venue partners to translate the creative vision into real-world execution on time and on budget


Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership
Sitting at the intersection of Gold House brand, partnerships, Gold House Studios, and Gold House Ventures  - this role is fundamentally collaborative. 

- Act as a thought partner and creative sounding board to leadership on brand decisions, visual communications, and creative investments
- Direct and provide consistent feedback to internal designers, content producers, and creative contractors; set clear standards and maintain them
- Identify, brief, and manage external creative partners when necessary — photographers, videographers, motion designers, set designers, editors— as needed across projects

- 10+ years of experience in creative direction, with a portfolio that demonstrates sustained brand-building across visual identity, campaigns, events, and digital

The expectation is a genuine, ongoing creative relationship with Gold House: present for the biggest moments, available for direction on the day-to-day where needed, and invested in the long-term evolution of the brand. We see this as the foundation of a longer creative partnership — and, for the right person, the beginning of a full-time chapter.

Join Our Spiro·Verse 

THIS IS A REMOTE OPPORTUNITY IN THE US.

Company Overview

This is Spiro. A strategically-led, creatively-driven, leading global experiential agency. We exist to cultivate powerful brand connections through the channel of experiential. We believe strong global communities are empowered by diversity, inclusion & belonging.

Where data-informed creative meets advanced digital solutions, we boldly go where no experience has gone before. As Spiro



- nauts, we are born storytellers & story makers; fearless dreamers of the “what if;" and pioneers of innovation in our craft. Together, we launch brands into their experiential orbit through the power of Brand Gravity.

Learn more about who we are here!

Position Overview

Do you consider yourself one heck of a storyteller? Do you thrive on shaping not just ideas, but entire creative organizations? Are you as passionate about building teams and culture as you are about delivering breakthrough work? Do you know how to balance bold creative ambition with real business impact?

Then we want to talk to you!

We’re looking for our next Executive Creative Director to lead our Creative team: someone who will define the creative standard, inspire our global team, and partner across the business to deliver transformational experiences for our clients.

Our ideal candidate is a visionary leader, a builder of teams, and a driver of creative excellence — someone who elevates not only the work, but the people and the business around it.

You are a proven creative leader with a track record of building high-performing teams and delivering world-class work across multiple channels. You are currently leading senior creative talent and are ready to shape the direction of an entire creative organization. You balance vision with execution, creativity with business acumen, and inspiration with accountability.

Responsibilities



- Lead and oversee the creative direction of the organization across multiple accounts, clients and regions.
- Define and uphold the creative standard, ensuring all work aligns with Spiro’s brand promise and delivers exceptional quality.
- Manage, mentor and inspire Creative Directors and senior creative staff, building a strong, scalable creative organization.
- Serve as a senior partner to executive leadership, influencing company-wide strategy, growth and innovation.
- Own high-stakes client relationships, representing the creative vision at the most senior levels.
- Drive new business efforts by shaping big ideas, leading pitches and elevating Spiro’s creative reputation in the market.
- Ensure alignment between creative vision, business objectives, operational realities and client expectations.

Specific Functions



- Set the creative vision across the organization and ensure consistency across all outputs and teams.
- Partner with Strategy, Production, Sales and Marketing leadership to shape integrated, experience-led solutions.
- Oversee the conceptual development of large-scale, high-impact programs and initiatives.
- Provide high-level creative direction and final approval on key work.
- Lead and evolve creative processes, frameworks and standards to improve efficiency and output quality.
- Champion innovation — driving the adoption of new technologies, tools and approaches to elevate creative thinking and execution.
- Build and nurture a culture of creativity, collaboration and continuous growth across the global team.
- Guide resource allocation and team structure to support business needs and creative excellence.

Experience Design and Event Expertise



- Engagement marketing activations
- Brand Identity
- Tradeshow programs
- Launch Events
- Conferences
- Environmental – physical, visual and digital

Supervisory Responsibilities



- Daily interaction with creative staff (2D, 3D) on your projects.
- Function as a creative stimulus.
- Support department head the EVP, ECD, as requested, for feedback on creative team that work most closely with you on account related work.

Qualifications

We understand the importance of transferable skills and a diverse perspective, so if you do not fit all these requirements, we still want to hear from you and encourage you to apply!



- Minimum of four year degree in Graphic, Architecture or Industrial Design or related creative discipline.
- Minimum 10 years industry experience or related creative process experience combining strategy, content, message with creative deliverables.
- Event and experience design expertise highly desirable.
- Prior supervisory responsibilities.
- Ability to lead, motivate and inspire the creative and our client teams, while keeping the creative process in alignment with Spiro/Client business goals and objectives.
- Understanding of all dimensions of communication: business strategy and experience design, with the ability to translate this into effective innovative, but integrated marketing programs.
- Broad-based exposure to 3D art, design, technology, music, media and content a must.
- Mac, Adobe Creative Suite, PowerPoint and AI proficiency (Modeling software is a plus).
- Understanding of all dimensions of communication: business strategy and experience design, with the ability to translate this into effective innovative, but integrated marketing programs.

Attributes



- Team Player
- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills required.

Benefits 



- Remote Environment
- Full Benefits Package
- 401K Vesting Immediately
- Psychological Safety
- Diversity, Inclusivity and Belonging Culture
- Employee Led Resource Groups
- Spiro
- YOU Professional Development & Learning Programs

Our Process

In general, you can expect to have an initial phone interview with our talent acquisition team and thereafter video interviews with team members and your future manager. We welcome candidates to view our social medial channels and website to extend the conversation beyond the responsibilities of the role. jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.descriptionText:
The Creative Director works with Philanthropy Communications and Integrated Marketing leadership to shape how Dana-Farber Cancer Institute’s philanthropic mission is expressed through compelling storytelling, brand strategy, and integrated creative campaigns that support the Division’s fundraising and donor engagement goals. The Creative Director plays a key role in ensuring Dana-Farber’s philanthropic storytelling connects donors with the transformative impact of their generosity. This position reports to the Assistant Vice President (AVP), Philanthropy Brand Communications.

This position's work location is fully remote with occasional time on-campus in Brookline, MA. The selected candidate may only work remotely from a New England state (ME, VT, NH, MA, CT, RI).

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities



- Serve as the creative lead for the Division of Philanthropy, shaping how Dana-Farber’s mission and impact are communicated through brand storytelling and integrated campaigns. Partner with senior marketing leadership to align creative strategy with fundraising priorities and institutional goals.
- Develop and lead creative strategies for major fundraising initiatives, including donor communications and integrated marketing across the Division. Translate institutional priorities, fundraising objectives, and audience insights into compelling creative approaches and storytelling frameworks.
- Oversee end-to-end creative development across channels, from concept through execution for print, digital, video, social, photography, and experiential donor engagement. Ensure integrated creative approaches connect platforms and touchpoints into a cohesive narrative.
- Use insights to strengthen performance and engagement, applying audience research, performance data, and campaign learnings to refine strategy and improve storytelling and design effectiveness. Balance creative intuition with data-informed decision-making to drive measurable impact.
- Steward and evolve brand standards within philanthropic communications, maintaining consistency for Dana-Farber and The Jimmy Fund while encouraging thoughtful innovation. Review and guide creative work to uphold high standards of design quality, storytelling, and brand alignment.
- Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver cohesive campaigns, partnering with Integrated Philanthropy Marketing, Philanthropy Communications, fundraising teams, writers, strategists, and digital teams. Serve as a creative advisor across the Division, including reviewing results with partners and applying learnings to future work.
- Lead, mentor, and strengthen the creative function and operations, guiding designers and art directors through clear direction, feedback, and development. Improve processes and workflows, ensure on-time/on-budget delivery, manage freelance/vendor relationships, and contribute to planning and strategic discussions that shape philanthropy marketing.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required



- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across a People leadership: Mentoring and growing creative teams, setting direction and standards, managing budgets/timelines/vendors, and improving workflows.
- Industry and design knowledge: Expertise in design thinking, typography, and layout, as well as other forms of marketing.
- Data and insights capability: Using research, segmentation, testing, and performance metrics to optimize creative and improve engagement.
- Cross-functional influence and stakeholder management: Partnering with senior leaders and diverse teams, aligning priorities, navigating feedback, and building consensus.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: Directly supervise members of the creative team, including designers and art directors, and collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across the Division of Philanthropy.

Minimum Education

MINIMUM JOB QUALIFICATIONS: 

Bachelor’s degree required preferably in graphic design, visual communication, marketing, or a related field.

Minimum Experience



- 6+ years of relevant work experience in in creative leadership, brand design, or marketing communications.
- Strong portfolio demonstrating impactful creative work across multiple channels.
- Deep understanding of brand systems and integrated marketing campaigns.
- Exceptional storytelling and visual communication skills with the ability to translate complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives.
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including marketing, digital, and communications.
- Strong presentation and communication skills with the ability to articulate creative vision and strategy.
- Experience developing integrated campaigns across digital, video, and traditional channels.
- Ability to apply audience insights and performance data to inform creative strategy and campaign development.

License/Certification/Registration

None

At Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, we work every day to create an innovative, caring, and inclusive environment where every patient, family, and staff member feels they belong. As relentless as we are in our mission to reduce the burden of cancer for all, we are committed to having faculty and staff who offer multifaceted experiences. Cancer knows no boundaries and when it comes to hiring the most dedicated and compassionate professionals, neither do we. If working in this kind of organization inspires you, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Principal Tools & Pipeline Technical Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.descriptionText:
As a Technical Artist for Tools/Pipeline, you'll employ your expert-level knowledge of 3D tools to build tools, maintain pipelines, and provide technical support for artists on their most critical missions. You will establish and improve the systems, tools, rigs, assets, and workflows that unleash the creativity of our artists and allow the production of the best possible art content for our players. And you will critique work, mentor fellow Rioters, and foster the long-term growth of a group of artists.

As a Principal Tools & Pipeline Technical Artist on an unpublished R&D product, you'll focus on building the tools and tech used for content development on an upcoming game project. This will involve building pipelines and workflows for DCC (Digital Content Creation) software, and consulting with art to discover the best possible solutions to the challenges the project team faces. You report directly to the Technical Art Director of the project.

Responsibilities



- Communicate a cohesive vision and standard for art vision, artistic workflows, and pipelines based on the Art Director and Creative Director’s visions.
- Assist in evaluating new systems and technology that support the artistic, product, and gameplay goals.
- Help to identify new opportunities to incorporate technology to increase art workflow efficiency and unlock new creative opportunities.
- Amplify artistic capabilities while maintaining efficient and sustainable memory and performance
- Lead the team in identifying new opportunities to incorporate technology to increase art workflow efficiency and unlock new creative opportunities
- Partner with other Technical Art leaders at the studio to develop a cohesive vision and shared standards across the Technical Art discipline

Required Qualifications



- 7+ years of professional experience as a technical artist in games or related industries
- Professional experience working within the games industry
- Expertise in industry-standard content creation tools, such as Maya, and commercial game engines (i.e. Unreal, Unity, etc.)
- Fluency in modern scripting languages and related UI frameworks, such as Python and PyQt/PySide
- Experience problem-solving and communicating with multiple art disciplines and acting as an ambassador between art and engineering

Desired Qualifications



- Experience in game development using Unreal
- Experience writing shaders and working in HLSL
- Understanding of 3D modeling, efficient UV layouts, and materials
- Strong understanding of current console art pipelines

When submitting your application, please provide a portfolio of your high-quality tech art - including stylized artwork. And as a part of the application process, you may also be asked to complete an art test.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Motion Graphics Artist
jobs.descriptionText:
Position Summary
When you work at Daktronics, you’ll be part of something amazing. We design, engineer, manufacture and support bold, eye-catching digital LED display technology and audio systems.
Our products bring excitement to professional, college and high school games. They attract customers for businesses around the world, and even provide direction for people as they travel, work and play.
As part of the Daktronics team, you’ll have interesting, impactful work with flexible opportunities. You can learn and grow at a company that provides competitive compensation and meaningful benefits – and the people are second to none.
What will the work look like for me?
Daktronics is seeking a highly skilled Motion Graphics Artist to create dynamic 2D and 3D content for large-scale LED displays. Producing work seen in major league stadiums, collegiate athletics, and global brands. In this role, you’ll bring visual storytelling to life, from concept through final delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with the Creative Director, Art Directors, and cross-functional teams to develop high-impact content under tight timelines. This is a hands-on role requiring both strong creative vision and deep technical expertise, with opportunities to lead smaller teams and projects.
What You’ll Do

- Design and produce high-quality 2D and 3D motion graphics for LED display systems.
- Create motion graphics optimized for a wide variety of screen sizes, shapes, and unique LED configurations, ensuring each piece meets client specifications and real-world display requirements.
- Leverage knowledge of emerging AI-powered creative tools and platforms to enhance workflows, generate concepts, and unlock new creative opportunities while maintaining high standards of craft and originality.
- Translate creative direction into compelling visual storytelling.
- Stay current on motion design trends, tools, and emerging technologies—applying new techniques and workflows to continuously elevate creative output.
- Solve complex design challenges independently and as part of a team.
- Lead design efforts on select projects and support/mentor other artists as needed.
- Partner with editors, producers, and designers to resolve technical and creative challenges.
- Maintain organized project files and follow best practices for workflows and version control. 
Why Daktronics
At Daktronics, you’ll create content experienced by millions, enhancing live sports, retail environments, and public spaces around the world. For more than 50 years, we’ve delivered innovative LED display and audio solutions to clients ranging from hometown businesses to major league stadiums. You’ll work with cutting-edge technologies and push the boundaries of motion design, including HDR, AR/VR, and immersive visual environments. We foster a culture of collaboration, respect, and continuous improvement, where your work has real impact.
Where is this opportunity located? 
Position has opportunity to work from a US Based home office. This position is open to candidates eligible to work in the United States.
What are the pay and perks?
The typical hiring range for this position is $68,000 to $78,000 annually. The high end of this range is reserved for candidates located in high cost of living areas. Candidates in other locations may fall within the lower to midpoint range. The actual offer will consider a wide range of factors, including relevant education, experiences, location, and applicable local legislation.
Information about Daktronics benefits can be found on our website Career Opportunities (daktronics.com) . This information is intended to be a general overview and may be modified by Daktronics at any time.
Qualifications
To be considered for Motion Graphics Artist, we require the following:

- Bachelor’s degree in design, animation, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- 5+ years of motion graphics experience in sports, broadcast, agency, or similar environments.
- Strong portfolio/demo reel showcasing a wide range of creative styles.
- Advanced proficiency in:
- Cinema 4D (modeling, lighting, animation, dynamics, Redshift, etc.).
- Adobe After Effects (2D/3D design and animation).
- Familiarity with Unreal Engine is a plus.
- Strong understanding of sports.
- Experience creating content for live events, sports, or large-format displays.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
- Detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and able to work independently.
- Experience with broadcast real-time graphics.
- Basic HTML knowledge.
- Ability to work with a fast-paced, highly collaborative creative team.
- Effectively exercise discretion and independent judgment.
- Fluent in English, written and verbal.
- Applicants must be 18 years of age or older.
- Daktronics does not sponsor, renew, or extend immigration visas for this position. 
Ready to make an impact? Apply now and start your journey with Daktronics. 
Daktronics is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Cosm was born from the fusion of some of the greatest innovators in the history of technology. Evans & Sutherland, Spitz, Inc., and Cosm Immersive combined forces to power the immersive experiences of the future as Cosm. Innovation is in our DNA.

The VFX Supervisor is the point person for deciding internal tasking on shots, conducting efficient review of artists’ work, and has overall responsibility for internal sign-off on “final” shots.

In addition to overseeing projects, this role places a strong emphasis on securing new projects through pitching across a wide range of opportunities. Our VFX Supervisor must bring exceptional communication skills along with complete enthusiasm and commitment to every pitch and project they support.

Key to the success of the role is a broader commitment to the success of the company, a genuine willingness to contribute where needed in a wide variety of roles on all projects, and leadership skills to inspire and mentor the next generation of artists.

Responsibilities



- Work closely with vendor partners to ensure that our shared vision is met, constantly improving each production
- Provide creative and technical input during pre-production, working with in-house Creative Directors and Producers along with potential production partners to plan show approaches, identify key challenges and propose solutions
- Work closely with the Producer to ensure an accurate production schedule is defined and maintained
- Collaboratively lead projects from concept to delivery, ensuring the creative vision aligns with internal expectations and external partners
- A willingness to assist other projects across the Cosm Entertainment Productions team, which may include working on the box
- Oversee the technical and creative direction of each shot and sequence for Experiential Cinema and Originals content
- Daily review of assets and work in progress
- Manage and handle internal communications with company leadership as well as external vendors and partners for clarity of deliverables, schedules, clearances, and budgets
- Build and maintain internal and production partner relationships
- Working alongside the Sr Director Entertainment Production, the Associate Production Director and/or the show Producer to find ways to execute projects within budget and schedule
- Responsible for forecasting for future show demands
- Work closely with the Creative Technologies team on pipeline improvements and developments
- Work with Technical Developers and Pipeline teams to make improvements, focusing on workflow
- Work out necessary element, technical and R&D requirements
- Attend shoots to ensure that VFX needs are considered during filming and the appropriate data is captured while providing guidance to the Director, DOP and internal stakeholders
- Attend artist interviews as needed, and keep an eye out for outstanding talent
- Mentorship of the next generation of artists by nurturing, guiding and leading by example

Experience



- Extensive experience in visual effects including recent supervision experience both studio-based and on location
- Minimum of 10+ years of experience in VFX with 5+ years supervising complex projects
- An entrepreneurial spirit, a passion for the company and dedication to delivering all projects to the best ability
- Expertise in Nuke, Maya, Houdini, Unreal GPU and CPU rendering
- A thorough understanding of color theory and film application for live-action film including film stock, film grain, color space and look-up tables, film processing and DI processing
- A great leader with the ability to inspire and lead by example
- Collaborative skills, ability to work well with others and enthusiasm to be involved in a variety of projects

The annualized base salary range for this position in California is $140,000 to 190,000. The base salary offered will factor in internal equity and may also vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and relevant experience, among other factors.

jobs.title: Director, Creative Production
jobs.descriptionText:
Highwire is reimagining what a Director of Creative Production can be. We are an AI-native, sector-expert, outcome-obsessed partner to the world's most innovative companies. As our Director of Creative Production, you are responsible for overseeing the intake, estimation, negotiation, and staffing of the Creative team across a growing portfolio of complex, multi-scope client engagements. You'll also support the team in ensuring that the processes around all disciplines are executed with a process that starts with a brief and ends with on-time delivery, in partnership with our Account and Project Manager roles. This position reports to the VP and Creative Director and combines Creative and Project Management responsibilities.

About you:

You are ruthlessly organized and motivated by the smooth, efficient competition of tasks against a plan. You understand how creative people work and protect their time and energy as fiercely as you protect deadlines. You navigate ambiguity and change without losing momentum, and you know how to bring a team along as the path is still being built. You look around corners and habitually have alternative options. Your teammates rely on you and know they can trust you to keep them on target, and aware of any potential derailments. You adore spreadsheets, Gantt charts and checklists, and you thrive on process. You're able to think on your toes and be resourceful in finding solutions to problems and answers to questions without strong oversight.

Key Responsibilities



- Serve as the operational connective tissue between Creative and cross-functional partners
- Implement consistent creative-first project management processes across key pieces of business
- Own the project intake and briefing process, ensuring every engagement enters production with a clear, approved creative brief before work begins
- Lead the development of statements of work (SOWs), project estimates, and production proposals that accurately reflect creative scope, team capacity, and delivery timelines.
- Manage budgets for project-based work and report budget performance
- Manage production across concurrent, high-visibility client scopes, including enterprise-level accounts with multiple workstreams running simultaneously
- Support pre-production, production, and post-production workflows across video, motion, and experiential projects, coordinating with internal teams and potential vendors
- Partner with Creative leadership to establish intake, briefing, and project kickoff standards that support creative quality from the start
- Articulate strategic plans, consult at a strategic level with clients, and have an in-depth understanding of the budget-setting process
- Take ownership of team staffing, working with other staffing representatives across the agency 
- Be prepared to report progress and next steps as required daily, weekly and at project conclusion
- Continue involvement in the execution of account work while steadily increasing responsibility over teams and client deliverables 
- Identify projects with case study potential early and partner with Creative leadership to ensure documentation planning is considered 

Candidate requirements 



- 8+ years above the producer/project management level, and experience leading multiple concurrent, complex, highly visible projects without supervision
- Agency experience, including planning, scheduling, and coordinating with external partners and clients (i.e., in a client-facing role)
- Proven ability to manage change, rally teams around new directions, and drive adoption of processes in a fast-moving environment
- Experience managing cross-functional relationships, including the ability to work assertively and collaboratively across competing priorities
- Demonstrated experience producing video, motion, and/or experiential projects in an agency environment, including vendor management and multi-market coordination.
- Experience running print/document production, strategy, digital, pre-production video and/or web development projects
- Understanding of specific quality assurance requirements for interactive or web-based deliverables, including user experience testing
- Demonstrated ability to work within AI-native production environments, including the use of AI-assisted tools for project planning, scoping, and workflow optimization
- Familiarity with CMS, social media platforms, Creative Cloud, Google Workspace/G-suite and Mac preferred
- Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a related field, or the equivalent combination of education and experience

The salary range for this position is $110,000 to $135,000, with the final offer based on a combination of factors, including education, relevant experience, skills, prior training, internal equity, and local geographic market data. This role also includes a competitive benefits package with medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, generous paid time off, and additional perks designed to support your overall well-being and growth.

Highwire is a strategic marketing communications agency at the intersection of innovation and industry. We partner with ambitious companies and established brands to navigate complexity, lead markets, and grow with purpose. With integrated expertise in strategic marketing and communications, corporate reputation, creative, and insights, we cut through the noise to deliver bold ideas and measurable impact across B2B technology, healthcare, cybersecurity, energy, professional and financial services, and more.

At Highwire, we believe that storytelling fuels transformation. We know that the most impactful stories represent all voices and perspectives. We're looking for individuals with big ideas, strong opinions, and the energy to bring them to life. If you thrive in an environment that values personal accountability, high standards, and boundless motivation, this is the opportunity for you. Be part of our award-winning culture and contribute to an exciting and growing business where you can make a real impact.

Highwire. Above all.

Company Description

Givebutter is the most-loved nonprofit fundraising and CRM platform, empowering millions of changemakers to raise more, pay less, and give better. Nonprofits use Givebutter to replace multiple tools so they can launch fundraisers and events, use donation forms and donor management (CRM), send emails and text blasts—all in one place. Use of the Givebutter platform is completely free with a 100% transparent tip-or-fee model.

Givebutter has been certified as a Great Place to Work® every year since 2021, and is the #1 rated nonprofit software company on G2 across multiple categories.

Our mission is to empower the changemaker in all of us. We believe giving should be fun, so you’ll want to do it again, and we also believe that work should be fun, so that you’ll have the greatest impact. We are excited to hear from talented people who want to work with other talented people in making the world a butter place—and have fun along the way.

Role Description

Givebutter is a joyful brand with a serious mission, helping changemakers raise over US$ 10 billion so far. Over 84,000 nonprofits trust us for their core operations — fundraising, donor management, finances — and we're investing in world-class design to empower the next generation of changemakers.

Design at Givebutter looks different than it did a few years ago. While the role and goals of design have not changed, the craft of designing great experiences is being rewritten in real time. Part of this role is defining what great product design looks like in an AI-native company: which problems AI owns, where human judgment still wins, and how a team works when the tools and workflows shift often.

You'll manage a growing team of product designers across product pods, partnering closely with the VP of Design to set direction, remove roadblocks, and raise the quality and velocity of design across the platform. If you're energized by building teams, shaping design culture, and figuring out what design becomes in this next era, we want to hear from you.

We Want To Hear From People Who…



- Are experienced people managers who know how to nurture great design talent, give meaningful feedback, and build a high-performing team. 
- Think strategically about design — not just what to build, but how design creates business value and drives positive outcomes for our users. 
- Are natural collaborators who build alignment across Product, Engineering, Brand, and executive leadership. 
- Hold a strong point of view on craft and quality, and know how to keep the bar high without becoming a bottleneck. 
- Thrive in high-growth environments where the org is still evolving, and autonomy is the norm. 
- Are not afraid to get hands-on when needed, and actively explore AI tools and coding agents to improve their craft. 

Responsibilities



- Lead and develop a team of product designers across multiple product pods, including direct ownership of hiring, performance, and career growth. 
- Partner with the VP of Design on design strategy, org design, and how the design function scales over time. 
- Create the conditions for designers to do their best work: align stakeholders, manage cross-functional dependencies, and drive clarity into ambiguous projects. 
- Set and hold the craft bar across the platform — interaction patterns, visual execution, design system standards, and long-term product quality — keeping it consistent as the team and surface areas grow. 
- Help define how product design operates at Givebutter, establishing how the team designs with AI tools and for AI-driven product experiences. 
- Act as a strategic design partner to senior Product and Engineering leaders, shaping cross-functional decisions and aligning teams around shared outcomes. 
- Influence product strategy through deep insight into our users (fundraisers and donors), turning ambiguous cross-product problems into clear direction for the team. 
- Make high-stakes design decisions that balance craft, speed, and business impact, with a company-level ownership mindset. 
- Help evolve Givebutter's design culture as the team grows, establishing practices, norms, and rituals that scale. 

Requirements



- 8+ years of product design experience, with 3–5 years managing other designers
- Strong portfolio demonstrating design leadership across complex, multi-surface product environments with clear impact on users and business outcomes. 
- Proven ability to develop designers at different career stages and build team culture intentionally. 
- Deep craft sensibility. You can define what "great" looks like across interaction design, visual design, and design systems, and hold that bar across a team. 
- Experience working closely with Product and Engineering leadership as a strategic partner, influencing roadmap and product direction through design. 
- Strong judgment on prioritization. You know when to go deep, when to delegate, and how to focus a team on the highest-impact work. 
- Excellent communication. You can tell a clear story to an exec audience and give a junior designer actionable feedback the same day. 
- Comfortable operating in a high-growth, ambiguous environment where priorities evolve and speed matters. 
- Genuine fluency with how AI is reshaping design, both the craft of designing AI-driven experiences and the way designers work day to day. 
- SaaS or B2B product experience required; nonprofit or social impact experience is a plus. Experience designing AI-native, automation, or agentic product experiences is a strong plus.. 

More about Givebutter

Benefits



- Remote Work: Work remotely from one of our 10 hubs (Austin, Denver, Indianapolis, Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Salt Lake City, Minneapolis, Seattle, and Nashville). 
- Health Insurance: We offer Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance covered 100% for employees as well as HSA and FSA accounts. 
- Dependent Care Coverage: We offer coverage for dependents, with 50% of Medical, Dental, and Vision premiums covered for all eligible dependents. 
- Mental Health: Givebutter health insurance plans come with access to a TalkSpace membership. 
- 401k: We offer a 3% 401k match for all eligible employee's. 
- Vacation and Holidays: Givebutter offers a Flexible PTO policy with uncapped vacation days and company-recognized holidays. 
- Wellness Week: Givebutter closes for one week each summer to prioritize rest and recharge for the entire team. 
- Parental Leave: We offer 12 weeks of paid leave for all parents and comprehensive leave planning management through Aidora. 
- Family Care Support: Access a company-paid UrbanSitter membership plus care credits to book trusted, background-checked caregivers for childcare, senior care, pet care, and household support when you need it most. 
- Home Office Stipend: Upgrade your home office with company-sponsored expenses, including high-quality laptops, monitors, and modern technology. 
- Coworking Stipend: Enjoy a monthly stipend that gives you the freedom to work from coworking spaces or cafés whenever you need connection, community, or a change of scenery. 
- Charitable Giving: Employees are encouraged to donate up to $50/month to any verified nonprofit they wish to support on Givebutter. 
- Professional Development: We offer learning and development reimbursement opportunities. 
- Love What You Do: We are a mission-driven company serving the charitable sector. Feel good about the work you're doing and the company you work for. 

Interview Process

Below is a high-level outline of our standard interview process



- Recruiter Screen: A 30-minute conversation to learn more about your background, walk through the role, and ensure mutual alignment on expectations, values, and logistics. 
- Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper dive into your relevant experience, skillset, and working style. This is your first opportunity to connect directly with the person who may be your future manager. 
- Assessment (technical or non-technical): This stage will vary based on the role. It could involve a live coding session, case study, or take-home project. Some roles may include two parts to this stage to evaluate both practical skills and problem-solving approaches
- Values Interview: A conversation with team members focused on how you align with our core values and leadership principles. 
- References: We connect with a few folks you’ve worked closely with to get a better picture of your working style and impact. 
- Offer: If all goes well, we’ll move to the offer stage!

Please note, we will have an AI note-taking tool join most of our interviews.

Description

We’re looking for a Associate Creative Director (Design) with a passion for retail and a keen eye for art direction to join the online/offline retail team at Ring. This role is focused on delivering impactful brand work across our product launches, seasonal campaigns and all other retail touchpoints for our biggest retail partners in the US. We are looking for someone who can design for both digital and print, including complex 3-dimensional structures, while also helping evolve our retail standards. You will set the look and feel for our brand campaigns and help visually communicate complex product stories and features across a wide range of products for the brand.

You’ll collaborate closely with channel marketers, marketing managers, production, brand designers, and product partners to bring intuitive, visually engaging solutions to life. Your work will help customers understand and connect with Ring’s mission of making neighborhoods safer.

Key job responsibilities



-  Lead end-to-end retail design projects and translate complex ideas and features into clear and impactful shopping experiences for the brand.
-  Design engaging assets across Rings retail marketing campaigns for online/offline and events.
-  Understand customer research, A/B testing, and behavioral data so it can inform design decisions.
-  Conduct site visits and audits to evaluate existing retail spaces, recommend improvements, and maintain consistency across locations.
-  Present work to leadership and wider teams with a clear strategic point of view.
-  Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, channel, production, and manage external vendors/contractors to deliver cohesive and on-brand retail experiences.
-  Stay ahead of industry trends, materials, and technologies to introduce innovative design solutions that enhance shopper engagement and drive business results.

ABOUT VAYNERX

VaynerX (https://vaynerx.com) is the most contemporary family of companies, working together to build and grow brands. Subsidiaries include VaynerMedia, Eva Nosidam Productions, The Sasha Group, Gallery Media Group, Tingley Lane Trading, VaynerSpeakers, and VaynerCommerce.

ABOUT VAYNERMEDIA 

VaynerMedia is a contemporary global creative and media agency with an expertise in driving relevance for clients and delivering impactful business results. The independently-owned company was founded in 2009 by Gary Vaynerchuk, and has offices in New York, Los Angeles, Toronto, Mexico City, London, Amsterdam, Singapore, Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, Tokyo, and Sydney. VaynerMedia has been recognized for its work at Cannes Lions, the Clio Awards and The Webby Awards. It is part of the VaynerX family of companies.

ABOUT VAYNERX

VaynerX (https://vaynerx.com) is the most contemporary family of companies, working together to build and grow brands. Subsidiaries include VaynerMedia, Eva Nosidam Productions, The Sasha Group, Gallery Media Group, Tingley Lane Trading, VaynerSpeakers, and VaynerCommerce. Director, Creator Management

ROLE SUMMARY

The Director, Creator Management leads the "Creators" pillar within the CAIT (Creators, Affiliates, Influencers, & Talent) department for their assigned pod.

This role is a leader who goes beyond simple Creator procurement to set the creative standard from the initial brainstorm through to the final SMA (Social Media Ad), ensuring the department's output is cast for relevance, directed for quality, and optimized for views.

You will oversee the strategy and operations for sourcing high-volume, diverse makers and talent to fuel our clients' brand channels. You will bridge the gap between the CAIT team and the cross-functional team, ensuring that our external creator network is integrated directly into the AIM (Analyze, Ideate, Make) workflow to drive SMA Excellence.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



-  Strategic Integration & SMA Excellence
- The New "Creative" Director: Partner with Client Partnerships, Strategy, and Creative leadership to architect creator-first campaigns. You will translate high-level brand concepts into casting strategies, ensuring we use creators to solve creative problems (diversity, volume, authenticity) that internal teams cannot solve alone.
- AIM Session Leadership: Oversee the integration of Associates and Residents into AIM sessions. Train the team to proactively pitch creator-led concepts that drive business results, moving the CAIT team from an "order taker" to a strategic partner.
- Quality Control: Define and enforce the standard for SMA Excellence. Ensure the team understands the distinction between "Creator as Talent" (delivering raw performance/assets) and "Veditor" (technical assembly), ensuring delivered assets are creatively effective and commercially safe.
- Virtual Directing Protocols: Establish the frameworks and training for "Virtual Directing," empowering your team to guide creator talent toward the right performance while the footage is still being shot.
-  Team Operations & Financial Health
- Mentorship: Manage and develop a team of Associates and Residents. Train them to think less like project managers and more like Casting Directors and Producers.
- Pipeline Management: Oversee the end-to-end operational health of the Creator pillar. While Associates handle execution, you are accountable for the systems regarding contract negotiations, payment processing, and project timelines to ensure speed and compliance.
- Margin & Efficiency: Monitor the financial health of creator projects within your pod. Optimize workflows to reduce rounds of revisions and ensure we are delivering high-volume assets at a margin that works for the business.
- Risk Management: Serve as the escalation point for complex creator negotiations or usage rights issues, protecting the agency and client from liability.
-  Industry Thought Leadership & Business Growth
- The Subject Matter Expert: Serve as VaynerMedia's internal authority on the Creator Economy. You are the person Account Directors call to help sell a CAIT incremental scope to a hesitant client, and the person Strategy looks to for the latest on platform creator trends.
- External Representation: Represent VaynerMedia at industry panels, events, and new business pitches, articulating our unique "Creators as Talent" philosophy.
- Trend Analysis: Turn trends from the creator economy into actionable business opportunities for our clients.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



- 7-10 years of experience in social media, creative advertising, or talent management.
- Creative/Operator Hybrid: You have the taste level to improve a piece of creative work and the operational brain to manage the budget and timeline behind it.
- The Seller Mindset: You are comfortable in a room with clients, articulating the business value of creators and defending creative decisions.
- Practitioner Empathy: You understand the friction points of making content (because you've done it) and can build workflows that remove barriers for both the creator and the agency.

Leadership



- Servant Leadership: You work for your team, not the other way around. You are responsible for creating an environment that fosters health, development, and inclusivity.
- Emotional Intelligence: You catch stress, fear, and anxiety in your team and convert it into practical optimism. When you need an outlet, you let it flow up, never down or across.
- Recruiting Partner: You actively partner with recruiting to support Vayner's talent practices and build the best possible team.

Accountability



- Clouds and Dirt: You are a practitioner who balances high-level strategy (clouds) with execution (dirt). You understand that the work matters, but how you get there matters even more.
- Social-First Lens: You are accountable for carrying out your role with a social-first mindset, ensuring all output meets the Vayner standard of excellence.
- Ownership: You take responsibility for actions and impact, pointing thumbs (at yourself) and not fingers (at others). You navigate the team through challenges without placing blame.

Communication



- Kind Candor: You deliver feedback that is clear, direct, fair, and empathetic. You view feedback as a gift and a catalyst for personal growth.
- Persuasion & Clarity: You can lead complex conversations and presentations at a moment's notice, delivering messages in a clear, authentic way to get buy-in from stakeholders.
- Navigating Difficulty: You prioritize and navigate difficult conversations effectively, setting the example for the team.

Growth Mindset



- "Yes, And": You practice a mindset where all voices are valuable. You view challenges as opportunities to create something better.
- Change Management: You help guide teams through change, collaborating with senior levels to share what's working and accelerate growth across the company.
- Risk Taking: You identify opportunities for junior team members to take risks and give them the permission to challenge themselves.

Unsure if you meet the qualifications? We are always looking for talent which will continue to cultivate an inclusive and representative team that will enhance our perspectives, skill sets, background, and behaviors. We encourage those who are passionate about what we do to apply!

ABOUT WARREN JAMES
Warren James is the leading creator commerce partner for top digital talent. We build premium consumer products and brands at the intersection of content, fandom, and commerce - spanning DTC, retail, licensing, and new category expansion. Our work blends creative instinct, operator discipline, and speed.


Warren James designs and publishes board games and tabletop products built on creator IP, most recently collaborating with Dropout to create Game Changer: Home Edition (~$6M raised as of early June). This is one of our fastest-growing lines, and we are building it from a hit-driven pipeline into a repeatable, multi-title studio. We are looking for a General Manager to lead WJ Games.


The Role
The Head of Games owns Warren James Games end to end - the division P&L, the release slate, and the operating system that turns creator IP into a repeatable engine. This is an operator's role with creative taste. Your job is to make the eighth and twelfth title land as reliably as the first.


This is a build-and-run leadership role. You will set the slate and the greenlight discipline, decide what we own versus rent, hire and lead the core team, and be a credible partner to creators and their representatives. You can zoom out to run the division like a business and zoom in to pressure-test a launch plan, distribution, a price tier, or a unit-economics model.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN


Division P&L & Commercial

- The full Games P&L - revenue, contribution margin by title and channel, and the working capital that defines games/tabletop economics (MOQ, tooling, fulfillment timing) - in partnership with Finance
- The royalty stack across creator, campaign manager, distributor, and Warren James
- The greenlight/kill discipline - the campaign average order value architecture and the contribution floor that decide which titles earn effort


Crowdfunding

- End-to-end campaign management across Kickstarter, Gamefound, and emerging platforms - pre-launch audience build, the live campaign, pledge-manager conversion, and the handoff to fulfillment
- Campaign pricing and tier architecture - the base / hero / collector structure, add-ons, and stretch goals that lift average order value to the contribution floor without breaking audience-product fit
- Performance marketing - directing the agency layer (e.g., Jellop, Crowdfunding Nerds, BackerKit Services) against funnel economics, with the discipline to scale what's working and kill what isn't, fast
- Metagame and community engagement - deploying interactive campaign mechanics where the IP warrants it (and recognizing when it doesn't), to drive comments, findability, and sustained funding rather than the typical front-loaded curve
- Platform strategy - the per-title call on Kickstarter vs. Gamefound vs. direct-to-consumer, and the broader go-to-market sequencing that turns a creator audience into a funded launch


Slate Strategy & Sequencing

- The slate: which titles, formats, at what price tiers, on what cadence (targeting 5–8 releases a year)
- The launch calendar - staggering releases to avoid concurrency crunches across design, production, and fulfillment
- The IP filter - a repeatable method for judging which creator / talent IP works as games/tabletop - and the per-title call on crowdfunding vs. retail vs. both, including knowing when not to force a title against its audience


The Operating System - the durable asset

- The playbooks, partner network, and performance data, documented so the studio’s know-how lives in the system, not in any one person’s head
- The campaign and production playbook, internalized over time so the studio depends less on outside consultants


Team & Org

- Hiring and leading the core team - designer, developer, campaign manager, and production management - and maturing retail into an owned function
- The freelance designer roster and the external partner layer (crowdfunding agencies, manufacturers, fulfillment, pledge managers)
- The talent flywheel that lets the studio scale title count without scaling headcount linearly
- Working with game inventory network for access to new game engines and concepts that can be easily married with creators.


Creator, IP & Retail

- Partnering with our creator/IP team on the pipeline; being a credible face to creators and their representatives, and helping shape deals
- The post-campaign retail conversion strategy and channel-specific product design - designing for a premium crowdfunded edition and a clean retail standard from day one


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE


First 3 months

- Full command of the division P&L, the in-flight slate, and the partner/vendor stack - you can speak to unit economics and working capital on every active title
- A clear read on the team and the freelance roster, including the most urgent hire to make
- An initial, written point of view on the IP filter and the greenlight bar


First 6 months

- A documented IP-evaluation filter in use on live opportunities, and a slate-planning cadence the team runs to
- The most urgent roles hired or in final stages; single points of failure being retired
- The next-year slate drafted with explicit AOV and contribution-floor discipline, sequenced to avoid crunch


First 1 year

- A functioning operating system: IP filter, slate cadence, and an internalized campaign playbook that no longer lives with consultants
- The core team in place and the designer roster producing; the creator pipeline converting in partnership with the IP team
- The year’s slate executing on plan - with margin and cadence, not just top line, as the scorecard


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


Must-Haves

- P&L ownership for at least 7 years in games/tabletop
- Deep fluency in games economics, seven-figure crowdfunding, retail/distribution (mass and hobby), and creator/licensed IP
- A track record of building and scaling a small team and an operating system - ideally taking a studio or product line from a few titles to many
- Demonstrated ability to hold creative judgment and commercial discipline at the same time - you can greenlight
- A lean-team, rent-production operating philosophy: a clear instinct for what to own versus rent
- Strong unit-economics and working-capital literacy


Strong Nice-to-Haves

- Direct creator / influencer-economy experience or relationships
- Hands-on crowdfunding operator background (ran or oversaw seven-figure campaigns)
- Retail buyer relationships across mass and hobby channels
- Experience with the crowdfunding-to-retail crossover


WHO YOU ARE

- You think like an owner and care about outcomes, not activity
- You hold creative taste and commercial discipline at once
- You build systems that outlast you, rather than becoming the system yourself
- You’re credible with strong personalities - creators, agents, designers, executives
- You operate lean and hands-on, and you know what to own versus rent
- You bring calm, clarity, and pressure in the right moments


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
Nobody runs creator-IP games/tabletop at portfolio scale yet. Warren James has the pieces - creator relationships, in-house design, a proven crowdfunding motion, and emerging retail - but the advantage only compounds if someone owns the system that turns them into repeatable hits. That is this role. It is the difference between a studio that services its next launch and one that builds a durable engine.


REPORTING & STRUCTURE

- Reports to the CEO
- Co-owns the creator/IP interface with Business Development leadership; coordinates with our trading-card-game line on shared infrastructure
- Manages the designer, developer, campaign manager, and project / production management; the freelance designer roster; and the retail function (solid or dotted line)


COMPENSATION

- Competitive Salary
- Performance bonus
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- 401(k) with company match
- Remote-first, with periodic team offsites


HOW WE WILL HIRE FOR THIS ROLE
1) Interview with the CEO 
2) Interview with Game Designer, Chief Revenue Officer, and Chief Operating Officer 
3) Case study 
4) References, including at least 2 people that can speak to your previous game launches


HOW TO APPLY

- Apply via LinkedIn Easy Apply
- Complete the required Google Form (link - https://forms.gle/3hopzeD3cSs5KcTLA)


The Google Form includes:
• Short written responses to key questions
• The Culture Index survey


We aim to close the loop within 4-6 weeks of the first screen.


Applicants who do not complete the Google Form and Culture Index survey (embedded in the Google Form) will not be moved forward.

Requirements

 Description & Requirements 

 who we are

About This Team

lululemon Global Brand Identity is the studio responsible for defining and evolving how the brand looks and feels at the highest level — across every channel, market, and touchpoint. We sit at the intersection of brand strategy and craft, building the visual systems, design language, and creative standards that shape lululemon’s global presence. This is a studio with a strong point of view, uncompromising taste, a high bar for craft, and a belief that brand identity should be felt as much as seen. We work at the speed of culture and hold ourselves to the standards of the best design studios in the world.

a day in the life: what you’ll do

Art Direction

- Develop presentation materials that build alignment with cross-functional partners
- Use creative performance feedback to sharpen future executions

collaboration & production

- Build strong working relationships across brand marketing, campaigns, product, and regional teams

craft & culture



- Bring exceptional typographic and compositional craft to every execution — held to the standard of the best brand studios in the world
- Maintain a genuine pulse on culture — design, fashion, art, sport, music, technology — and bring that fluency into the creative process
- Contribute to a studio culture defined by high standards, creative curiosity, and collaborative generosity
- Share knowledge and feedback generously with peers and junior team members

what you’ll bring

Skills & Approach



- A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional typographic sensibility, compositional rigor, and the ability to execute coherent visual systems, not just beautiful one-offs
- Experience executing brand identity or expression systems for ambitious brands
- A genuine and practiced eye for culture: fashion, art, music, design, sport, and the fluency to translate that into brand-relevant creative decisions
- Strong conceptual thinking: the ability to move from brief to idea, and from idea to a system of executions

A note on portfolio

We review portfolios carefully and weight them heavily in our evaluation. We’re looking for work that demonstrates a singular point of view — not versatility for its own sake. Show us the work you’re most proud of and the thinking that drove it.

Experience

- A track record of executing creative at a consistently high standard across multiple channels

- Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure. 
- Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships. 
- Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.

Immigration support is potentially available for this role.

Compensation And Benefits Package

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance.
